editorial: Vibrant explosions of reality swirl as you step into a fever dream. Its blend of cosmic horror and superhero swagger turns familiar portraits into uncanny mentors and foes. The climactic flood scene, where water bends into a living entity, showcases practical effects rarely seen in big-budget blockbusters. The second act drifts into a methodical maze of door-to-door confrontations that stalls pacing. Fans of cerebral, high‑concept thrillers will be drawn into this chaotic ballet of bending realities.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
